facts.value: Transferring from the Maricopa County Community College District to Arizona State University can be a smooth process when planned. As a Maricopa student, you have a couple of ways to earn your bachelor’s degree at ASU. Find what works best for you and we'll help you plan your path.

facts.value: MyPath2ASU® helps you plan and complete prescribed coursework designed for a smooth transition to ASU to earn your bachelor's degree.
